role: 女主角 / 李斌的妻子
privacy_note: 原文中妻子的身份做了隐私保护处理；本锚点仅用于漫画视觉表现，不映射现实人物。
style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

demographics.height_impression: 160-164cm, slightly shorter than husband, often wears low heels at home
demographics.skin_tone: fair, well-maintained, foundation always visible (she wears makeup at home)

hair.style: long straight black hair, waist-length, often tied in a low ponytail at home, down when going out
hair.texture: smooth, dyed ends slightly brassy from sun
hair.color: natural black roots with subtle dark brown ends

face_features.eyebrows: shaped, high arch, thin to medium thickness — gives a permanent scrutinizing expression at rest
face_features.eyes: double eyelids, larger and rounder than husband's, dark brown, sharp focus, often narrowed when scolding
face_features.mouth: medium lips, well-defined lip line (lipstick even at home), corners often pursed when displeased
face_features.distinctive_marks: fresh manicure with nude-pink gel polish (a recurring detail in the story); pearl stud earrings

wardrobe_default.top: fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top, slightly cropped, tucked in at the waist
wardrobe_default.bottom: light grey high-waisted yoga leggings at home; charcoal A-line midi skirt when going out
wardrobe_default.footwear_brief: light grey memory-foam house slippers, fluffy cuff
wardrobe_default.accessories: small gold locket on a thin chain (visible at neckline), hair tie on left wrist as bracelet, smartphone in a rose-pink silicone case
wardrobe_default.fit: form-fitting at home, always put-together — visual contrast with husband's worn t-shirt

wardrobe_alt.yoga_class_going_out: black sports bra layered under a sage green zip-up jacket, charcoal leggings, white sneakers, hair in high ponytail, tote bag with a yoga mat strap
wardrobe_alt.yoga_class_returned: same going-out outfit, slightly flushed cheeks, hair slightly loosened, holding a plastic bag of leftover snacks

default_posture: spine straight, chin slightly raised, one hand often on hip or holding something — a 'ready to inspect' stance

scene_anchors.bedroom_guest_room_entrance: standing in the doorway at 45-degree angle to camera, one hand on the door frame, toothbrush in the other hand during morning calls
scene_anchors.living_room_doorway: standing in the doorway between bedroom and living room, hand on hip, scanning the room
scene_anchors.kitchen_table_exit_morning: standing at the front door, one hand on the doorknob, the other hand adjusting her bag strap
scene_anchors.balcony_doorway_pointing: standing at the balcony sliding door, one finger pointing toward the plant pot

angle_descriptions.front_view: face-on, symmetrical, chin up — gives a 'surveying' presence
angle_descriptions.three_quarter_view: head turned 30 degrees to her right, eyes sharp toward off-camera target — most common during scolding
angle_descriptions.side_profile: head turned 90 degrees, ponytail silhouette visible, jawline clean — used when she storms past camera
angle_descriptions.low_angle: camera below waist level looking up — used to emphasize her dominance in argument scenes
angle_descriptions.high_angle_overhead: camera above looking down on her — used rarely, only when she sits dejected (almost never in this story)
angle_descriptions.over_shoulder_behind_husband: camera behind husband's head/shoulder, her full figure sharp in background — used heavily to show 'being watched / judged' from husband's POV

lighting_preference.default: soft window light from the left (camera-right), warm overall, slightly overexposed skin — she 'glows' more than husband
lighting_preference.morning_bedroom_doorway: backlit by hallway light, hair rim light, face slightly in shadow — intimidating silhouette
lighting_preference.evening_living_room: warm TV-backlight glow on her face when she sits on the sofa, the room otherwise cool
lighting_preference.night_climax: single ceiling light from behind camera, casting her shadow forward onto husband — she becomes 'the light source'

motion_anchors.brushing_teeth_walking: one hand holding electric toothbrush, the other gesturing while talking, slight head bob
motion_anchors.pulling_curtain_open: both hands gripping the curtain edge mid-chest height, body weight on front foot, head tilted back slightly
motion_anchors.pointing_at_cabbage_powder_or_smoking_ci: index finger extended, arm straight, head tilted forward, eyes locked on target
motion_anchors.door_slam_or_throw_pillow: right arm cocked back, wrist flicked, body twisted — physical punctuation of speech
motion_anchors.adjusting_outfit_before_yoga: one hand pulling zipper up, the other tucking hair behind ear, looking down at her own reflection

do_not_include: page-panel watermark text — added per-prompt in Step 6

usage_note_for_step_4_5_6: 后续分镜或生图提示词中，对妻子的描述必须**原文引用**本文件中 `face_features`、`wardrobe_default`、`default_posture`、`angle_descriptions`、`motion_anchors` 中的具体短语，不得使用文件名标注或文件链接引用。
